overview: The Sanguine Caves are the mutation crucible of Bloodfalls, where crimson water and void-taint combine to create dangerous beasts.
history: Crimson water seeped into natural caverns, mutating wildlife.
Void-scar fissures opened beneath the cave floor.
Sanguine beasts began spawning from corrupted pools.
The caves became the primary source of Bloodfalls’ mutated creatures.
hooks: Sanguine beasts swarm a void-scar pool.
Coterie ritualists attempt a dangerous experiment.
